guesses.reason: Short dense coat in warm brown with black mackerel/ticked striping, an M-marked forehead, and a lean, typical kitten build point to a random-bred brown tabby.
The classic brown tabby coloring and a rounded face with a white muzzle bear some resemblance, though the body is slimmer than the breed standard.

breed.appearance: A slim, young brown tabby kitten with a short coat of warm tawny-brown fur, grizzled with black ticking and broken mackerel stripes on the body, plus bold dark bars on the legs and a ringed tail ending in a solid black tip. She has large, tall, pink-lined ears, wide yellow-green eyes, a dark-rimmed brick-pink nose with a peachy-orange patch above it, and a white muzzle and chin with long white whiskers. She wears a bright orange collar and sits alert with one front paw raised, gazing upward.
breed.fun_fact: Brown tabbies are the classic 'wild-type' cat coat, and every one of them wears a signature 'M' on the forehead like a built-in name tag!
